My view on Indian Defence Industry Boom on @ @MeenakshiRajat @IndiaDaily_24X7 Panel with Hon @anujshikari2000 

As global conflicts expose the fragility of over-dependence on Chinese and American defence systems — from missile failures to supply chain vulnerabilities — India’s defence manufacturing sector is quietly becoming the world’s most compelling alternative. India’s defence exports hit an all-time high of ₹38,424 crore in FY 2025-26, a staggering 63% jump year-on-year, with buyers spanning 80+ countries including Germany, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Australia, the Philippines (BrahMos), France (in talks for Pinaka), and a growing base across Africa and Latin America. 

￼ This is a 21x growth over the previous decade ￼ — not an accident, but a structural shift: the twin wars in Ukraine and West Asia, plus the Armenia-Azerbaijan conflict, have accelerated demand from nations urgently rearming and looking beyond traditional suppliers. ￼ 

Armenia’s acquisition of Akash SAMs and Pinaka rocket systems, Indonesia’s BrahMos deal, and France’s potential Pinaka procurement represent a historic reversal — former arms exporters are now buyers of Indian platforms. ￼ With a target of ₹50,000 crore in defence exports by 2029 and domestic production already exceeding ₹1.27 lakh crore ￼, India isn’t just filling a gap — it is methodically positioning itself as the trusted, non-aligned defence supplier of a fractured, rearming world.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ @rajnathsingh @SpencerGuard @Rahulk123d @AdityaDharFilms @SpokespersonMoD @DefProdnIndia @binaysrikant76 @adgpi @makeinindia @ZahackTanvir @DrSonuBhaskar @surabhi_tiwari_ @majorgauravarya @DcWalaDesi @anandmahindra @AdaniKaran

Philippines and US stage counter-landing drills with allies near South China Sea

As simulated enemy boats and unmanned craft closed in on the shores of Palawan island facing the South China Sea, Philippine and U.S. forces conducted counter-landing drills on Monday, repelling a mock assault by using live fire against designated targets and intercepting threats.
